about: RhinoAI's MCP tools as the Claude tab sees them through RhinoAI's router (mcp__rhino__<name>), grouped by behavior. From rhino_mcp_tools_reference.md for RhinoAI 0.3.0-wip (C:\Dev\RhinoAI at 0276594, 2026-09-28) plus the router's own slot tools. Update this file when RhinoAI's tools change; it is read when a Claude tab starts its first message. Tools not listed here are not allowed.

excluded.ask_user: its questions and answers go to RhinoAI's own panel, not to the Claude tab -- ask in your reply instead

guidance: Start with get_context: selection, active viewport, document summary, Grasshopper canvases in one call.
Find objects with list_objects (filter by name, layer, type) or get_selection; select with set_selection, frame them with zoom_to_object or zoom_to_layer.
Look at the result with get_viewport_image: an image plus camera metadata.
Omit the slot argument: it uses this Rhino.
Grasshopper: g1_* tools for Grasshopper 1, g2_* for GH2; search_components / describe_component before placing, apply_graph to place and wire several at once.

Two run_python tools: script-editor's runs inside the user's paused script (its variables); rhino's (when allowed) runs a separate new script against the document -- use its injected __rhino_doc__, not scriptcontext.doc or rhinoscriptsyntax.
run_command (when allowed) runs any Rhino command string, e.g. _Box 0,0,0 10,10,10 _Enter, and returns the command line output.
